evals.name: design-contained-source-runtime
evals.subject: source-runtime-design
evals.prompt: Design the installed layout and verification plan for a TypeScript CLI named report-builder that ships inside an Agent Plugin installed from Git. The installed Skill must run offline with Node 22, must not execute TypeScript, and must not reach back into the repository application directory.
preconditions: The editable CLI source uses TypeScript and has a lockfile
End-user installation cannot run a package manager
assertions: Separates editable application source from the independently copied Skill
Uses a contained mjs launcher generated runtime emitted JavaScript and exact production dependency closure
Requires path containment symlink rejection offline execution and an isolated-copy smoke test
Provides a namespaced vendor runtime manifest without changing portable manifest fields
evals.expected_output: A source-runtime layout and evidence plan that can run after Git installation without repository coupling.

evals.name: project-native-release-matrix
evals.subject: native-release-design
evals.prompt: No implementation language has been selected for report-builder. Prepare its native release projection on Linux x64 and arm64, macOS x64 and arm64, and Windows x64. Explain the staged Skill layout, target-specific evidence, checksums, and alignment with the source command.
preconditions: No implementation language or toolchain is specified
TypeScript is the documented default branch
Only native CI execution can prove target runtime behavior
assertions: Selects the TypeScript default branch without asking the user to repeat absent language information
Places exactly one target executable under the Skill scripts directory
Excludes source runtime TypeScript and repository application files
Requires native smoke tests and parity checks without claiming cross-compilation proves execution
evals.expected_output: A deterministic cross-platform native projection and verification matrix.

evals.name: reject-mixed-installed-runtime
evals.subject: runtime-safety-audit
evals.prompt: Audit an installed Skill whose scripts directory contains both tool.mjs and a native tool binary while runtime/node_modules is also present, although plugin.json declares native-bun. State the verdict, the minimal correction, and tests required before installation.
preconditions: Treat the described package as untrusted
Do not execute either ambiguous entrypoint
assertions: Fails closed because declared native mode contains mixed runtime material
Does not choose an entrypoint by precedence or execute TypeScript
Requires a clean regenerated native stage rather than deleting arbitrary installed files
Names tamper checksum wrong-target and clean-environment regression tests
evals.expected_output: A blocked verdict and safe regeneration plan with no invented precedence.

evals.name: route-whole-plugin-release
evals.subject: scope-routing
evals.prompt: Le runtime du script est déjà conçu et testé. L’utilisateur demande maintenant de valider le manifeste complet, installer le plugin dans Goose et publier les archives. Explique le transfert de responsabilité et les preuves à remettre, sans prétendre effectuer la publication.
preconditions: No release authorization is available in this scenario
assertions: Routes whole-plugin validation installation packaging and release to plugin-creator
Hands off the command contract and both runtime layouts
Hands off artifact hashes and test results
Identifies every untested platform cell
Keeps Skill authoring responsibility separate from plugin release responsibility
Does not claim installation or publication occurred
evals.expected_output: A precise evidence-bearing handoff to plugin-creator.

evals.name: design-rust-target-specific-packaging
evals.subject: rust-runtime-design
evals.prompt: Design source-install and tagged native packaging for a Rust CLI named index-builder using Cargo and a committed Cargo.lock. Cover Linux GNU x64, macOS arm64, and Windows MSVC x64 without compiling during end-user installation.
preconditions: Every supported target requires runtime evidence
The host may not compile during installation
assertions: Keeps Cargo source and build metadata outside the installed Skill
Uses exact target-specific prebuilt artifacts or marks Git installation unsupported
Records Rust toolchain target triple lock hash features and dynamic linkage
Does not apply Node launchers node_modules Python zipapps or online installation
evals.expected_output: A Rust-specific target and evidence plan with honest unsupported cells.

evals.name: design-python-zipapp-and-native-packaging
evals.subject: python-runtime-design
evals.prompt: Design source-install and native-release packaging for a Python CLI named dataset-checker managed by uv with a committed uv.lock. Its dependencies are currently pure Python, but explain how the plan changes if a compiled wheel appears.
preconditions: Native extensions must fail closed or become target-specific
assertions: Uses committed uv.lock and a pinned uv version to derive the locked build closure
Uses a deterministic contained Python source artifact without uv or pip at installation
Disables user and project package fallback
Records explicit interpreter constraints
Routes compiled wheels to target-specific artifacts or an unsupported verdict
Keeps Python source runtime and frozen native executable profiles mutually exclusive
evals.expected_output: A Python-specific zipapp and frozen-binary plan with native-extension boundaries.
